name: serine protease 1

function.text: PRSS1 encodes serine protease 1 [Cleaved into: Alpha-trypsin chain 1; Alpha-trypsin chain 2]. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase activity. It participates in proteolysis and extracellular matrix disassembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary chronic pancreatitis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
